correctness.rationale: Lagrange residue sums vanish in degrees 0..n-2 and equal one in degree n-1. Consequently the skew N built from u and Du satisfies N^2=NDN=0, giving exact orthogonal conjugation for every t. The invertible Vandermonde rank-three factorization proves rank Q=3. BWB=s4*all-ones forces Q^2=uu^T in n=5 and Q^2=0 from n=6, with Q^3=0. All 2^(n-1) sign directions are distinct. Smoothness of the diagonal two-quadric surface and the standard exactly-sixteen line theorem identify all Fano lines when n=5. Standalone exact arithmetic checker passed, with finite tests treated only as corroboration.

value.rationale: An all-simple-spectrum explicit construction at the first dimension beyond known rigidity gives a natural spectral-geometric mechanism rather than arbitrary finite examples; the exact sign orbit grows as 2^(n-1). The rank-three family has a non-obvious sharp nilpotency transition from Jordan (3,2) to three 2-blocks, and the 16 first-size directions exhaust the natural Fano-line mechanism. No theorem about the entire isospectral cone is claimed.
